views.name: v_school_profile
views.create_sql: /* Views thu cong cho database california_schools (Paper V-SQL style) */ CREATE VIEW v_school_profile AS SELECT schools.CDSCode, schools.School, schools.District, schools.County, schools.City, schools.Zip, schools.Latitude, schools.Longitude, schools.Charter, schools.FundingType, frpm."Academic Year" AS academic_year, frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_school_yn, frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12, frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_free, frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_frpm, satscores.rtype, satscores.enroll12, satscores.NumTstTakr, satscores.AvgScrRead, satscores.AvgScrMath, satscores.AvgScrWrite, satscores.NumGE1500 FROM schools LEFT JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
